title: California State Auditor reports that concern San Francisco
question: What has the State's own auditor published that examines a San Francisco body or relies on San Francisco as a case study?
finding: 16 State Auditor reports issued from 2018 to 2026 examine or draw on San Francisco; 4 list a San Francisco body among those audited.
how: The State Auditor's catalog was screened for reports that list a San Francisco body as auditee or mention San Francisco repeatedly in an audit of homelessness, housing, grants, health or social services. "Mentions" counts the words San Francisco in the report.
limits: Most of these are statewide audits in which San Francisco is one of several places examined. A high mention count shows relevance, not fault.
